System should have provision for connecting ships emergency DC supply. (24V/12V).
System should have audio and visual combined flash alarm unit.
System should have plug/socket box for connecting portable SPTs and portable headsets.
System should have group isolations (Armament, damage control, machinery group)
System should have screened cable network for interconnections between SPTs.
System accessories should meet Ingress protection on locations where it is going to be fitted. Weather decks – IP 66, Underwater comp. – IP 67, Other locations – IP 55 ratings.
If system is used in hazardous area, all SPTs connected to system shall meet the degree of intrinsic safety required for hazardous area.
Para 1 of Appendix C of EED 50-08
Where units are connected with ship's mains, fuse protection is to be provided.
All units to be provided by earthing bolts. Where units are connected with ships main supply, fuse protection is to be provided.
Para 4 of Appendix C of EED 50-08 (R1)
Metallic Block Diagram of System (should be fitted) Detailed Lay Out Diagram
Bolted type terminal and crimped socket of electrolytic copper are to be provided for all incoming and outgoing cables.
The equipment should be mounted on shock mounts.

The system should have audio and visual combined flash unit for machinery compartments/noisy compartments (for e.g. Flasher with Yoda light) and will be connected to individual SPTs directly or through relay box.

Group Isolation – System should have group isolations and one group should be able to communicate with the SPTs of other groups.
